title: OpenDEA-Compatible Asset Registration Record
description: One registration record per OpenDEA-compatible asset (CR-AM-11 section 11 + CR-AR-01 section Scope). Metadata and immutable references only - never model content. asset_class defaults to 'assessment' when absent (CR-AR-01 backward-compat shim).

id.description: Canonical asset identifier. Equals the filename stem.

asset_class.description: CR-AR-01 discriminator. Defaults to 'assessment' when absent (backward-compat shim). New asset classes require their own CR (CR-AR-01 §Scope constraint).

reference.description: IMMUTABLE reference: tag vX.Y.Z, 40-char commit SHA, or sha256 digest. main/master/latest/HEAD are forbidden (CR-AM-11 section 12).

commit.description: Optional full commit SHA corroborating the tag reference.

components.description: Reusable component references consumed by this asset (CR-AM-11 section 20).

reference.description: Immutable reference to the component release.

dependencies.description: Other registered asset ids this asset depends on.

compatibility.description: CR-AR-01 compatibility-axes generalisation. Optional for backward compatibility; new asset classes should declare their axes here per axes/catalog.yaml.

required_axes.description: Axes this asset MUST satisfy for cross-asset compatibility.

declared_axes.description: Per-axis declaration of how this asset satisfies each axis.

then.description: Semantic-class entries declare compatibility axes (governance + at least one technical axis).
Ontological-class entries declare compatibility axes (governance + upper-ontology choice).
Extension-class entries declare compatibility axes (extension kind + compatibility statement).
